subject: german
title: German Hellos
welcome_lead: Hallo, guten Tag — start a German conversation.
final_note: Greetings are the gateway to every chat.

walkthroughs.body_html: Hallo is casual hi — for friends. Guten Tag is formal — for teachers, shopkeepers, strangers. Use it whenever you'd say 'good day' in English.
Guten Morgen = good morning (until about 11am). Guten Tag = afternoon. Guten Abend = evening. Gute Nacht = good night (going to bed).
Auf Wiedersehen = formal goodbye. Tschuss (say 'choose') = casual bye. Bis bald = see you soon.
